decision.exact_command_or_message: Do not record an idle reason and do not start extra 5090 work. The 5090 is not idle: Shay allowed ONE 5090 lane (5090-i4) at ~22:40 and I spawned operator imm26-5090-i4-hard2b3 minutes ago. Its lane-setup, lane backend and launch have not yet taken the game lock, so the guard sees an idle 5090. Keep the waker armed (event-stream.sh --as event-wait) and wait for the operator's launch (game lock + inflight marker) or its first status update.
decision.why: The idle-5090 block is a transient start-up gap with a just-spawned operator on the one allowed lane; recording kenshi-ctl.ps1 idle only to quiet the hook is forbidden, and 5090-i3/i5 stay held by Shay so there is no other 5090 work to start.
